title: NZ in December with Kids — What to Expect (Weather, Crowds, Costs)
meta_desc: Discover what to expect in NZ during December with kids, including Christmas school holidays and peak season costs
intro: December is the most popular time to travel in New Zealand, with Christmas school holidays and warm weather drawing large crowds. However, this also means higher prices and busier attractions. If you're planning a family trip to NZ in December, it's essential to know what to expect. With some planning, you can still have a fantastic holiday without breaking the bank.

sections.heading: Weather in December
sections.body: December is summer in New Zealand, with warm weather and long days. The average high temperature in December is 23°C in the north and 18°C in the south. However, the weather can be unpredictable, and it's not uncommon to experience heavy rainfall or heatwaves. Be sure to pack accordingly, with sunscreen, hats, and light jackets for cooler evenings.

sections.heading: Christmas School Holidays
list: Schools typically break up in mid-December and return in late January
Popular attractions and beaches are busiest during this period
Book your accommodation and activities well in advance to avoid high prices and availability issues
Consider visiting popular spots early in the morning or later in the evening to avoid the crowds

rows: Holiday home in Bay of Islands

sections.heading: Beach Destinations
sections.body: December is a great time to visit New Zealand's beautiful beaches, with warm weather and calm seas. Some popular beach destinations include the Bay of Islands, Coromandel Peninsula, and Abel Tasman National Park. However, these areas can get very busy during peak season, so be sure to book your accommodation and activities early. A drive from Auckland to the Bay of Islands takes around 3 hours, while a drive from Nelson to Abel Tasman National Park takes around 1 hour.

sections.heading: Booking Ahead
list: Accommodation: book at least 2-3 months in advance to secure the best prices
Activities: book popular activities like ski lessons or dolphin watching tours at least 1-2 months in advance
Transportation: book your rental car or campervan at least 2-3 months in advance to ensure availability

sections.heading: Getting Around
sections.body: With the crowds and long drive times, it's essential to plan your transportation in advance. Consider renting a campervan or car, or booking a domestic flight to save time. A campervan rental from a company like Britz or Maui can cost around $150-250 per day, depending on the time of year and type of vehicle. Be sure to also budget for fuel, which can cost around $2.50-3.50 per liter.
